title: OSCRCT_ colorectal cancer screening using artificial intelligence in computed tomography.
summary: In Germany, approximately 145 CT examinations / 1,000 inhabitants were performed in 2019. Within these CT examinations, an individual colorectal cancer risk assessment could potentially be collected with an AI-assisted analysis of CT image data of the liver without additional radiation exposure or additional examinations for the patients.

interventions.name:
Rectrospective analysis of image data of all patients with venous CT of the abdomen and complete colonoscopy, in case of inadequate image quality of venous CT abdomen the data of the patients cannot be analyzed. The time interval between CT and colonoscopy was defined as a maximum of 5 years.
After

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients with venous CT of the abdomen and complete colonoscopy
Time between CT and colonoscopy ≤ 5 years
Exclusion criteria:
Aborted/incomplete colonoscopy
Inadequate image quality of venous CT abdomen
Period between CT and colonoscopy > 5 years
